name: rfdiffusion2_design
description: Design protein backbones with RFdiffusion2, including atom-level enzyme active-site scaffolding around a small molecule. Give a contig string and a provider-side PDB that holds the motif residues, the ligands, and RFdiffusion2's ORI positioning atom. Returns each designed backbone as PDB text with residue, ligand, and motif summaries. One 180-residue design takes about 3.5 minutes on a 32 GB GPU.

contig_map.description: RFdiffusion2 contig string. Numbers are lengths of new backbone; chain-prefixed ranges are motif residues taken from input_pdb. Example: '46,A106-106,59,A166-166,2,A169-169,23,A193-193,46'.

input_pdb.description: PDB file name relative to the provider's RFdiffusion2 input directory, for example 'mcsa_41/M0584_1ldm.pdb'. The file must hold the motif residues, the ligands, and an ORI HETATM atom marking where the design is centered. Absolute paths, '..' segments, and URLs are rejected.

ligand.description: Comma-separated residue names of the ligands in input_pdb to design around, for example 'NAD,OXM'.

contig_atoms.description: Atom-level motif: maps a motif residue such as 'A106' to the comma-separated atom names to keep, for example 'NE,CD,CZ'.

contig_as_guidepost.description: If true, RFdiffusion2 chooses where in the sequence the motif residues go instead of fixing them to the contig order.

inference_steps.description: Number of flow-matching steps. Omit to use the model default of 100.

seed.description: Seed for a reproducible run. Omit for a random design.

return_structure.description: If false, return only the per-design summaries without the PDB text.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time for the call in seconds, including any wait for another design to finish on the provider.

dry_run.description: If true, validate the arguments, including that input_pdb exists on the provider, and return the Hydra overrides without running RFdiffusion2.

overrides.description: Hydra overrides a dry run would pass to RFdiffusion2.

num_atoms.description: Protein and ligand atoms in the design.

ligands.description: Ligand residue names present in the design.

residues_with_side_chain_atoms.description: Residues that carry side-chain atoms, as chain, number, and name (for example 'A66:ARG'). These are the scaffolded motif residues; newly designed residues are backbone-only.

pdb.description: Designed backbone in PDB format, when return_structure is true.
